items.source: Interactions with the underlying transactional resource will not be committed in this phase. See TransactionSynchronization.afterCompletion(int) for details.
items.translation: 与底层事务资源的交互在此阶段不会提交。有关详细信息，请参阅 TransactionSynchronization.afterCompletion(int)。

items.source: Note: This is a specialization of AFTER_COMPLETION and therefore executes in the same sequence of events as AFTER_COMPLETION (and not in TransactionSynchronization.afterCommit()).
items.translation: 注意：这是AFTER_COMPLETION的特化版本，因此其执行顺序与AFTER_COMPLETION相同（而不是在TransactionSynchronization.afterCommit()中）。

items.source: For more fine-grained events, use AFTER_COMMIT or AFTER_ROLLBACK to intercept transaction commit or rollback, respectively.
items.translation: 对于更细粒度的事件，使用 AFTER_COMMIT 或 AFTER_ROLLBACK 来分别拦截事务提交或回滚。

items.source: Note: This is a specialization of AFTER_COMPLETION and therefore executes in the same sequence of events as AFTER_COMPLETION.
items.translation: 注意：这是AFTER_COMPLETION的特化，因此与AFTER_COMPLETION在同一事件序列中执行。
